subject.title: feat(ui): browse Gateway and node folders from one root

question: After the correctness blockers are repaired, should node filesystem browsing and persisted node-specific working directories become a supported core Control UI and session contract?
rationale: The change adds an admin filesystem-browsing protocol and persisted session state across Gateway, node hosts, generated clients, macOS, and the Control UI; the linked issue is explicitly marked as needing maintainer product and security review.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Accept the unified host-browser and node-cwd direction once policy enforcement, macOS structure, focused tests, and real behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Keep typed node paths
options.body: Decline core node browsing and retain manual node-path entry without expanding the filesystem RPC and persisted session contract.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Approve node browsing only after redesigning a more constrained capability or path-selection API with a smaller security surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the unified host-browser and node-cwd direction once policy enforcement, macOS structure, focused tests, and real behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the existing folder-browser feature and has the strongest merged history across the affected node policy, UI, and macOS runtime surfaces.
